items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: I remember that name Renee. Kid Renee? Yeah, Kid Renee. I remember him.

ctx.x: Do you remember some of the other people that came from New Orleans?

I know some of the guys. Arthur Durbin, he played trumpet. He brought a band there but I can't think of all the guys that he brought with him. I remember Arthur Durbin, let me see now, who else can I say? Since so long. Do you remember Renee being there?
